Name: Farm-Themed Outdoor Furniture (CP)
Author: yuninocorn
Description:
[b][size=4]General[/size][/b]
This content pack adds a catalogue with over 200 furniture items that can be placed indoors and outdoors (though they are designed for outdoor use) to decorate your farm. 
You can purchase the Farm-Themed Outdoor Furniture Catalogue from Robin for 10000g. 

[b][size=4]Seasonal Changes[/size][/b]
Some of the furniture items look different throughout the seasons, such as the crop- and flower plots, seasonal grass, hedge, produce crates, and rose trellis. All furniture is covered in snow during the winter. There is a seasonal variant of the decorative grass that isn't shown in the mod page's pictures.

[size=4][b]Permissions[/b][/size]
If you want to make your own recolor/retexture, translation, or make any other kind of change to this mod and post it, you are free to do so and use my assets, as long as your mod is an add-on (using my mod as a dependency) and doesn't just copy/replace this one. Please only use my assets for the things you are changing.

Enjoy!
